Purpose: Controlled hover for precise positioning with quick entry/exit and stabilization. Used for construct placement and mid-air combat.

Behaviour:
- Toggle entry: A (Right) double-tap toggles hover on/off. Distinguish double-tap with params.value("double_tap_ms", 350). If on ground and double-tap A, enter hover at current position with vertical lock and subtle bob.
- Movement while hovering:
  - Left Thumbstick: strafe/forward movement in chosen locomotion orientation (read from CLocomotionSettings.mode for head or controller relative vectors). Speed limited by params.value("hover_max_spe

Copy and edit builtin.grab into generated.grabbable_pistol_pickup, bound to survival_pistol in alien_survival_zone. Preserve overlap-based either-hand grabbing and grip-socket alignment. Frame by frame, an eligible free hand squeezing Grip within params radius_m may acquire the pistol; align the asset's named 'grip' socket to that hand and record exclusive ownership so a second hand cannot attach. Releasing the same Grip immediately detaches the pistol and gives it modest smoothed inherited hand linear/angular velocity scaled by params drop_velocity_scale; this is a drop, not a powerful throw.
